V1-026_CAL-E01_75.scientific_ceiling: Descriptive comparator role, endpoint, coverage, retained status and common-completion integrity only; no CI, ranking, superiority, equivalence, activation or promotion.

V1-033_CAL-E02_128.scientific_ceiling: Register PARTIAL; M2C BLOCKED/PARTIAL; simulation-only; independent empirical ground truth NOT_EVALUABLE; chronology, selection-input, query-identity, endpoint-signature and truth-isolation gaps retained.

V1-045_CAL-E03_164.scientific_ceiling: Register/M2C PARTIAL; N=20/N=50 only; N=100/N=200 NOT_RUN/ABSTAIN; telemetry BLOCKED/null; one execution is not repeated-run reproducibility; ALS 60 stopping semantics, compiled 100/80 separation and topology amplitudes remain unresolved.

proposed_workflow.name: scope_authorization
proposed_workflow.action: Obtain explicit authorization for a selected subset or all 26 proposal units and separately identify permitted target files.

proposed_workflow.name: reviewable_patch_synthesis
proposed_workflow.action: Generate a standalone review patch/draft without mutating manuscript sources; convert V1-033 summaries and V1-045 contract items into paragraph-aware edits.

proposed_workflow.name: independent_claim_boundary_review
proposed_workflow.action: Revalidate every proposed sentence against the V1-026, V1-033 and V1-045 scientific ceilings before application.

proposed_workflow.name: manuscript_application
proposed_workflow.action: Apply the approved, reviewed patch to explicitly authorized manuscript files only.

proposed_workflow.name: compile_and_qa
proposed_workflow.action: Compile affected outputs and run locator, claim, citation and protected-boundary checks; compare final text with the approved patch.

proposed_workflow.name: formal_register_adjudication
proposed_workflow.action: Update the formal author decision register only under a separate explicit authorization and only after evidence-backed manuscript QA.

stop_conditions: Do not treat V1-033 paragraph summaries as verbatim replacement anchors.
Do not auto-apply V1-045 contract items as string replacements.
Do not convert any PARTIAL, BLOCKED, NOT_RUN, NOT_EVALUABLE, NOT_AUTHORIZED or NOT_RUN/ABSTAIN state to PASS.
Do not infer unresolved ALS stopping semantics, topology stress amplitudes, resource telemetry or repeated-run reproducibility.
Do not update the formal register in the same authorization as manuscript patch synthesis or application.
Do not use or compare e4_r008_primary_final or e4_r008_duplicate_final.
